progression.intent: Invite self-review of intended meaning and context.
progression.requires: learner asks for help or has a processed genuine error

progression.intent: Ask a meaning-focused question about the relevant relationship.
progression.requires: new attempt or explicit request for more help

progression.intent: Focus on the unmet semantic constraint and invite a new whole-sentence attempt.
progression.requires: new attempt or explicit request for more help

forbid: target tense names in any language
complete accepted answers or close paraphrases
formulas that identify the target construction
allow: reference to learner-provided wording without supplying its replacement
before_translation_acceptance.on_exhaustion: Offer to retry, skip, change activity, or explicitly end the assessed attempt before any worked solution. Never silently reveal the active target.

after_translation_acceptance: Ask the learner to identify and explain their actual construction. Give diagnostic feedback after their attempt or explicit help request; accept explanations in Spanish or English.
generation_input_contract: Before acceptance, provide the model only the Spanish prompt/context, stage, current learner evidence and the allowed semantic focus. Withhold authored accepted examples/tense labels unless evaluation architecture requires a separate private evaluator.
guard_contract: A stage-aware semantic guard must inspect candidate output for direct and indirect spoilers across languages and variants. On block or uncertainty, regenerate or use a reviewed neutral fallback without exposing rejected output.
guard_limits: Substring checks alone cannot establish no spoilers; adversarial fixtures specify behavior for future model/provider evaluations.
